name: LAUNDRY BEAR
description:
2026-07-23 | Exploitation of Zimbra Collaboration Suite via Zero-Day CVE-2025-66376
Target: Western government and commercial organizations using Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS).
Vector: View-based exploit in Zimbra webmail leveraging vulnerability CVE-2025-66376.
Impact: Exfiltration of 90 days of email communications, Global Address List (GAL) directory data, and persistent account compromise.

name: Iranian-Affiliated Threat Actors
description:
2026-06-23 | Iranian Threat Actors Targeting Critical Infrastructure PLCs
Target: Critical infrastructure sectors using Programmable Logic Controllers (PLCs) from Rockwell Automation, Schneider Electric, Siemens, and other OT manufacturers.
Vector: Exploitation of unsecured internet-connected OT devices, unauthorized manipulation of reusable code modules, and injection of malicious project files.
Impact: Operational disruption, potential physical control impairment, and unauthorized manipulation of HMI and SCADA display data.
